title: Software Engineer II, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We are looking for inquisitive, well-rounded Full-stack engineers to join our Core or Monetization Engineering teams. Working closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers, you’ll play an important role in enabling the newest technologies and experiences. You will build robust frameworks & features. You will empower both developers and Pinners alike. You’ll have the opportunity to find creative solutions to thought-provoking problems. Even better, because we covet the kind of courageous thinking that’s required in order for big bets and smart risks to pay off, you’ll be invited to create and drive new initiatives, seeing them from inception through to technical design, implementation, and release.

What you’ll do:

  • Build out full-stack Pinner-facing features to power the future of inspiration on Pinterest
  • Contribute to and lead each step of the product development process, from ideation to implementation to release; from rapidly prototyping, running A/B tests, to architecting and building solutions that can scale to support millions of users
  • Partner with design, product, and backend teams to build end-to-end functionality
  • Put on your Pinner hat to suggest new product ideas and features
  • Employ automated testing to build features with a high degree of technical quality, taking responsibility for the components and features you develop
  • Grow as an engineer by working with world-class peers on varied and high impact projects

What we’re looking for:

  • 2+ years of industry full-stack development experience, building consumer or business facing products
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience
  • Proficiency in one or more common backend and frontend tech stacks: e.g. Javascript, React, API, storage, caching and data processing
  • Experience in following best practices in writing reliable and maintainable code that may be used by many other engineers
  • Ability to keep up-to-date with new technologies to understand what should be incorporated
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times per half and therefore can be situated anywhere in Ontario.

We are looking for Data Scientists to join our Monetization Engineering organization. You will take end to end ownership of designing, researching, building, and delivering data products as well as collaborate with XFNs to formulate, experiment, and evolve Pinterest’s strategy in the Ads space.

What you’ll do:

  • Deep strategic analysis to answer core questions such as: How do we assess the trade-off between metrics change? How should we evaluate overall impact from changes in one component of the ads ecosystem?
  • Opportunity sizing and analysis. Should Pinterest adjust programmatic ad load based on ? Write clear, actionable analyses that help teams identify areas of improvement and investment.
  • Modeling: Build segmentation models to assess supply to inform pricing strategy.
  • Improve decision velocity and quality using data scientist tool kit: experimentation, causal inference techniques, etc. Design measurement strategy, advise on experimentation best practices, identifying flaws in experiment practices and results; building tools for experiment analysis etc.
  • Creating and tracking success metrics. Identify the right measures of success for engineering teams and help them track those metrics. Break down high-level metrics into actionable segments. This work may span from collecting entirely new datasets to building dashboards to track components of a metric (e.g., monitoring conversion data for missing values, implausible values, duplicated data, etc. by advertiser over time).
  • Leadership: Lead and mentor the scope of work for data scientists in the same area, demonstrating high-quality output of both yourself and others for whom you are responsible. Provide continuous and candid feedback, recognizing individual strengths and contributions and flagging opportunities to improve performance.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of combined post-graduate academic and industry experience applying scientific methods to solve real-world problems on web-scale data.
  • Strong fundamentals in statistics, experimentation.
  • Domain knowledge in ecosystem, ads, or real-time-bidding.
  • Proven ability to apply scientific methods to solve real-world problems on web-scale data.
  • Proficiency in SQL/Hive/Python.

As a Data Scientist in our Core organization, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build at Pinterest. Your expertise in quantitative modeling, experimentation and algorithms will be utilized to solve some of the most complex engineering challenges at the company. You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Product Analytics, Data Engineering and others. The results of your work will influence and uplevel our product development teams while introducing greater scientific rigor into the real world products serving hundreds of millions of pinners, creators, advertisers and merchants around the world.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop best practices for instrumentation and experimentation and communicate those to product engineering teams to help us fulfill our mission - to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love
  • Bring scientific rigor and statistical methods to the challenges of product creation, development and improvement with an appreciation for the behaviors of our Pinners
  • Build and prototype analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed for product development
  • Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience analyzing data in a fast-paced, data-driven environment with proven ability to apply scientific methods to solve real-world problems on web-scale data
  • Extensive experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches including in the fields of Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling, Forecasting, Econometrics or other related fields
  • Experience using machine learning and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn
  • A scientifically rigorous approach to analysis and data, and a well-tuned sense of skepticism, attention to detail and commitment to high-quality, results-oriented output
  • Ability to manipulate large data sets with high dimensionality and complexity; fluency in SQL (or other database languages) and a scripting language (Python or R)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain learnings to both technical and non-technical partners
  • A team player who’s able to partner with cross-functional leadership to quickly turn insights into actions
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field or equivalent experience

Canvas is a foundation text-to-image model developed internally for helping various visualization, inpainting, and outpainting products. In this role, you’ll get to work with Pinterest’s rich visual-text dataset to build large-scale generative models which are continuously being shipped to production to power visualization features.   • Mentor more junior researchers or research interns within the Pinterest Labs organization.

Pinterest is where hundreds of millions of people around the world discover ideas and turn inspiration into action. Our mission is to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and our values guide how we build, operate, and lead: Put Pinners First, Aim for Extraordinary, Create Belonging, Act as One, and Win or Learn.

Ads brings together Product and Engineering to build the products and systems that power Pinterest’s advertising platform across advertiser and Pinner experiences, enabling sustainable growth while protecting the quality and integrity of the product experience. This organization sits at the intersection of business strategy, scaled engineering systems, and product innovation, making it one of Pinterest’s most business-critical teams.

About the Role

We are hiring a Chief of Staff to the GM, Ads (Product, Engineering, Data Science) to help scale the organization, sharpen executive decision-making, and drive the operating agenda for this high-impact team. This Chief of Staff (CoS) will act as a senior strategic operator and trusted advisor who connects big-picture priorities with day-to-day execution, serving as a force multiplier for the GM and the broader leadership team.

The role is designed for a leader who can:

  • Operate as a thought partner to senior executives, with strong business and technical intuition
  • Build and run scalable operating mechanisms that drive clarity, accountability, and outcomes
  • Translate complex, ambiguous challenges into structured decisions, owners, and execution plans
  • Represent the organization in critical cross-functional forums with confidence and credibility across senior technical and business leaders

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a strategic partner and force multiplier to the GM, Ads and the broader Ads leadership team, helping them stay focused on the most important company and organizational priorities.
  • Own and continuously refine the executive operating agenda in partnership with leaders and TPMs, including strategic planning, goal setting, quarterly and annual business reviews, leadership offsites, and decision forums.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that improve Ad’s execution across Product and Engineering, operating effectiveness, and business impact, stepping in to drive structure, alignment, and momentum where ambiguity is highest.
  • Translate ambiguous business, technical, and organizational problems into clear frameworks, options, recommendations, and decisions for the VP and leadership team.
  • Use data, qualitative insight, and organizational “listening” to identify risks, diagnose operating gaps, and proactively surface tradeoffs and implications to leadership.
  • Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Data Science, Finance, Recruiting, People, and GTM partners, ensuring the Ads organization’s priorities, risks, and resource needs are well understood and integrated into company planning.
  • Design, implement, and evolve operating mechanisms that improve prioritization, decision quality, communication, and follow-through (for example, leadership cadences, decision logs, roadmap and investment reviews, and accountability trackers).
  • Support organizational planning and growth, including team structure, headcount and investment tradeoffs, leadership effectiveness, and operating-model evolution as the business and technology landscape changes.
  • Develop executive-level communications and narratives (for example, decision memos, business reviews, strategy updates, board and ET prep) that clarify strategy, progress, tradeoffs, and decisions for varied audiences.
  • Represent the Ads organization in critical forums with the Office of the CEO, other functional Chiefs of Staff, and cross-functional leadership groups, modeling the high standards of quality, efficiency, and operational rigor expected of the Office of the CEO and broader executive community.
  • Act as a culture carrier for Pinterest’s values, helping the organization Put Pinners First, Aim for Extraordinary, Create Belonging, Act as One, and Win or Learn in how it plans, executes, and communicates.
  • Collaborate with finance teams to manage budgets, optimize spending, and identify opportunities for efficiency and/or investment.
  • Understand, interface and work closely with recruiting and people orgs to evaluate and nurture healthy, cooperative engineering teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in strategic operations, business operations, program leadership, product operations, technical program management, consulting, finance, or a related role in complex, fast-moving organizations.
  • Experience operating as a trusted partner to senior executives or leadership teams, with a track record of shaping priorities, driving decisions, and landing complex, cross-functional programs.
  • Strong strategic judgment and systems thinking, with the ability to connect company and Ads priorities, organizational dynamics, technical realities, and execution constraints into a coherent plan.
  • Proven ability to lead high-impact initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through measurable outcomes, including establishing clear success metrics, governance, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Exceptional analytical skills; able to use both quantitative and qualitative data to diagnose issues, frame options, and influence decisions with clear, structured recommendations.
  • Outstanding executive communication skills, including the ability to craft concise narratives, decision memos, business reviews, and leadership communications for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust quickly, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders with competing priorities and perspectives.
  • Experience designing and scaling operating mechanisms, planning processes, or organizational systems that improve focus, execution, and cross-functional alignment.
  • High integrity, discretion, and judgment; comfortable operating with access to sensitive information and navigating nuanced people, organizational, and business situations.
  • Comfort working at the intersection of technical, product, and business environments; you do not need to be the deepest technical expert, but you must be able to engage credibly with senior engineering and product leaders.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering directly with Engineering, Product, or other technical executive teams as a Chief of Staff, strategic advisor, or senior TPM/strategic operations leader.
  • Experience in advertising, marketplace, platform, infrastructure, or other scaled technology environments where monetization, reliability, and user experience must be balanced thoughtfully.
  • Experience with organizational design, headcount planning, business planning, or executive-level operating rhythms (for example, OKR cycles, QBRs, investment reviews, or board/ET prep).
  • Experience partnering with Finance, Recruiting, People, or GTM teams on business-critical initiatives that span strategy, operations, talent, and culture.

  • Minimum of 2 years of regular experience querying and manipulating data using SQL.
  • Demonstrated experience using data to solve commercial or marketing challenges and influence stakeholder decisions.
  • Strong insight storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into clear recommendations for different professional audiences.
  • Experience building high-quality presentations in Google Slides, PowerPoint or an equivalent tool.
  • Confidence presenting analytical work to clients, agencies or senior internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to clarify ambiguous requests, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work independently.
  • Working knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methods, audience research, market intelligence or syndicated data.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with commercial and cross-functional partners.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken Spanish and English.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate analytical or research workflows, together with a clear approach to verifying accuracy, sources and quality.

The Responsible AI team is part ofthe Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.

At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.

Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations - ensuring these models are safe, bias-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies - to championing ML Fairness and developing user-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user-controllable skin tone, hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type.

You’ll help shape forward-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.

What you'll do:

  • execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI. 
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.
  • Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R-AI space.
  • Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.

What we're looking for:

  • Extensive, real-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology - spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.
  • Deep familiarity with cutting-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer-based models, 2-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large-scale Search and Recommender Systems.
  • Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state-of-the-art research with tangible product impact.
  • 2+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products
  • Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields
  • Nice to have:
    • Publications at top ML conferences
    • Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring
    • Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration
    • Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data
    • Passion for applied research and the Pinterest product

The Ads Quality team helps Pinners move from inspiration to action by showing the right ad at the right time.  We are at the core of the entire ads system optimizing for Pinner, Advertiser, and Pinterest value.  The output of this work will both be highly impactful (driving measurable value for Pinners and Advertisers) and highly visible (your launches will change the way the app looks and feels), and will critically contribute to our mission of helping hundreds of millions of people find the inspiration to create a life they love. 

The ideal candidate has a passion for delighting our Pinners and strong intuition about what matters most to their experience.  In addition, they must possess a deep understanding of the back-end systems, have worked cross functionally with engineering, data teams, and PMM and understand  the interaction effects of introducing qualitatively different content onto the page, and tradeoff dynamics of the ads marketplace.  

What you’ll do: 

  • Own a vision for new and existing capabilities that help match the right ad to the right Pinner at the right time, and translate problem statements into clear business and technical requirements through focused business requirements documents (BRDs) and product requirement documents (PRDs), including epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, for your area. Create and maintain a clear, prioritized roadmap and requirements backlog, track requirement status from discovery through GA, and ensure traceability from business goals to shipped features. Plan and deliver a sequenced roadmap, aligning with partner teams on architecture, guardrails, and experimentation so launches drive measurable advertiser and Pinner outcomes. Coordinate changes to well-defined components within back-end ads delivery systems (e.g., parts of retrieval, ranking, pacing/budgeting, auction/bidding, quality/diversity guardrails, conversion visibility, forecasting, modeling, or measurement) to meet product requirements.
  • Partner day-to-day with engineering, ML, data science/analytics, design, and research to deliver high-quality features; collaborate with PMM, sales, and policy/integrity as needed for launches. Work closely with PM peers across Ads Quality (e.g., retrieval, ranking, pacing/budgeting, measurement/incrementality, integrity) and with PMs on front-end presentation/components (e.g., modules, formats, surfaces) to manage dependencies, define APIs/contracts for your area, align on experiment design and guardrails, and coordinate GTM and feedback loops. Facilitate roadmap and requirements reviews, keep shared artifacts (roadmap, PRDs, dependency trackers) up to date, and proactively surface risks, decisions, and changes.
  • Build features within our ads bidding and optimization solutions that help advertisers clearly express objectives and align budgets to their business needs, while maintaining a safe, delightful Pinner experience. Deliver scoped improvements from discovery through launch and adoption, instrumenting metrics, writing documentation, and incorporating learnings into subsequent iterations. Define success metrics and acceptance criteria up front, track requirement completion and quality signals post-launch, and use insights to update the roadmap and next set of requirements.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 4 years of experience working as a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Data Scientist, or related role. 
  • Strong evidence of the ability to review and define new products and strategies with back-end products in an ambiguous space and to execute from ideation, roadmaps, to go-to-market.
  • Experience working with Engineering, data, or PMM cross functional teams and a strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and effectively collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders. 
  • Deep understanding of business metrics and tradeoffs in the contexts of online marketplaces
  • Experience with Ads Marketplace and/or Ads Formats 
  • Preferred but not required: Direct experience with and fundamental understanding of ads delivery systems. 
  • Preferred but not required: Design, run, or analyze marketplace experiments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience

Facilitate roadmap and requirements reviews, keep shared artifacts (roadmap, PRDs, dependency trackers) up to date, and proactively surface risks, decisions, and changes.

  • Build features within our ads bidding and optimization solutions that help advertisers clearly express objectives and align budgets to their business needs, while maintaining a safe, delightful Pinner experience. Deliver scoped improvements from discovery through launch and adoption, instrumenting metrics, writing documentation, and incorporating learnings into subsequent iterations. Define success metrics and acceptance criteria up front, track requirement completion and quality signals post-launch, and use insights to update the roadmap and next set of requirements.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong evidence of the ability to review and define new products and strategies with back-end products in an ambiguous space and to execute from ideation, roadmaps, to go-to-market.
  • Experience working with Engineering, data, or PMM cross functional teams and a strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and effectively collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders. 
  • Deep understanding of business metrics and tradeoffs in the contexts of online marketplaces
  • Preferred but not required: Experience with Ads Marketplace and/or Ads Formats

Your expertise in quantitative modeling, experimentation and algorithms will be utilized to solve some of the most complex engineering challenges at the company. You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a diverse set of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Product Analytics, Data Engineering and others. The results of your work will influence and uplevel our product development teams while introducing greater scientific rigor into the real world products serving hundreds of millions of pinners, creators, advertisers and merchants around the world. The core mandate is to evolve the organization from reactive moderation and lagging harm reporting into a proactive, metrics-driven operating system—where we manage leading indicators that predict risk, improve understanding quality, and keep Pinterest safe, inspiring, and useful.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop a deep, nuanced understanding of the Pinterest trust and safety platform, quantifying full funnel opportunities and risks
  • Lead projects on: Trust and Safety opportunities across different funnel stages
  • Design and productionize robust, scalable ML and evaluation frameworks—spanning statistical measurement, product recommendation, and forecasting
  • Develop best practices for instrumentation and experimentation and communicate those to product engineering teams to help us fulfill our mission - to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love
  • Bring scientific rigor and statistical methods to the challenges of product creation, development and improvement with an appreciation for the behaviors of our Pinners
  • Build and prototype analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed for product development
  • Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest

What we’re looking for:

The Corporate Strategy team sits at the center of Pinterest within the Strategy & Growth organization, helping to shape and communicate the company's multi-year growth strategy. We serve as the connective tissue between key product, engineering, sales, marketing and other cross-functional teams to accelerate Pinterest innovation and business growth.

This is a rare opportunity to join a company undergoing rapid transformation in a high-impact role, working on the most critical company-wide efforts. The Director of Corporate Strategy will stand up a new team from the ground up, carving out a new muscle for Pinterest that brings clarity and alignment around the existing strategy, shapes future strategic investments and identifies net new business growth opportunities for Pinterest. 

What you’ll do:

  • Define the Multi-Year Advertising Strategy: Lead the 3- to 5-year strategic vision for Pinterest’s global advertising business, identifying and prioritizing the most important growth opportunities across upper-funnel brand advertising and lower-funnel performance and shopping solutions.
  • Identify and Evaluate New Revenue Opportunities: Assess and prioritize opportunities for market expansion across Pinterest’s first-party and third-party advertising businesses. Partner closely with Business Development and Corporate Development to evaluate build, buy, and partner pathways.
  • Lead Competitive Intelligence for the Ad Tech Landscape: Drive ongoing analysis of the competitive and industry landscape, synthesizing key market trends, competitor performance, and external benchmarks into actionable insights for senior leadership.
  • Own Strategic Communications for Pinterest’s Advertising Vision: Develop compelling strategic narratives, executive presentations, and board-level materials to communicate Pinterest’s advertising strategy and key initiatives to the Head of Advertising, Chief Product Officer, and Board of Directors.

What we’re looking for:

  • Data driven and highly skilled in identifying and synthesizing game-changing insights
  • Excellent (verbal, written, visual) communication skills, with proven ability to develop and present compelling narratives to broad audiences
  • Strong business judgment, with an owners’ mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity
  • Experience in building trusted relationships and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization; including getting into the details to “become the expert” on an area of focus, then upleveling and clearly articulating the “so what” for others.
  • Curious and knowledgeable about the ads, ecommerce, and broader technology industry
  • Self-starter and excited about the prospect of building a team/function from the ground up
  • Multiple years of experience in Corporate Strategy, Finance, or a comparable role in high-growth tech companies
  • Proven ability with navigating a global organization structure and building strong collaborative relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, or equivalent experience.

Pinterest’s Service Configuration Deployment team builds the platforms, APIs, and tooling that make dynamic configuration and service coordination safe, scalable, and reliable for every service across regions and clouds, serving as the central hub for cross-functional alignment and system orchestration. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll own the end-to-end technical strategy and long-term vision for our configuration and coordination infrastructure. You’ll define the future of these mission-critical systems, partnering closely with Traffic, Compute, Observability, and Cloud Architecture teams to deliver robust, high-performance solutions at scale.

What you’ll do:

  • Orchestrate the long-term technical vision for configuration ecosystems to ensure feature flags, ML settings, and experiments utilize unified paved paths. You will champion operational safety through standardized validation, staged rollout mechanisms, and robust governance frameworks across the organization.
  • Spearhead the transition from legacy substrates by migrating mission-critical use cases to modern platforms. You will establish scalable onboarding patterns that enable engineering teams to evolve their configuration lifecycle with precision and minimal friction.
  • Architect the next generation of control plane interfaces and diagnostic surfaces. By engineering high-performance, read-optimized APIs, you will empower human operators and automated assistants to seamlessly manage and reason about complex production states.
  • Direct the integration of coordination stacks within the broader deployment and multi-region landscape. Your leadership will refine service discovery and substrate architecture to accelerate regional expansion while eliminating bespoke toil and architectural circularity.
  • Leverage AI to catalyze infrastructure design and analytical phases, utilizing assistant-enabled workflows to synthesize partner requirements into executable roadmaps. You will maintain absolute accountability through rigorous data validation, metric-driven reviews, and comprehensive peer verification.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 10 years experience in high-scale infrastructure and distributed environments, with a track record of architecting or managing business-critical backend substrates in production settings.
  • Proven expertise in orchestrating cross-functional technical strategies for control-plane systems (e.g., experiments, feature flags, or ML config), unifying disparate teams around standardized and safe rollout methodologies.
  • Advanced proficiency in distributed coordination and substrate design—capable of navigating complex consistency models, failure domains, and the engineering of resilient, high-leverage abstractions.
  • Experience aligning configuration surfaces with deployment pipelines and orchestration frameworks (e.g., IaC or CI/CD), with a focus on mitigating architectural circularity and reducing service owner toil.
  • History of elevating senior engineering talent while steering parallel workstreams, synthesizing loosely coupled initiatives into a unified technical vision and executable roadmap.
  • Ability to catalyze execution via AI-enabled workflows (e.g., design synthesis, analytical phases, or documentation) while ensuring rigorous accountability through data validation, peer review, and metric-driven verification.
  • Extreme ownership and professional integrity: dedicated to safeguarding data, maintaining human-in-the-loop oversight for automated outputs, and taking full responsibility for long-term architectural outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Pinterest’s Product ML Infrastructure (PMLI) team enables fast, safe, and efficient delivery of AI/ML solutions across Ads and Core critical products. We build unified data, training, feature, and inference infrastructure; this role will set technical direction across model training and serving, with a focus on GPU efficiency and large-scale ranking systems.

What you’ll do:

  • Set the technical vision and roadmap for model training and serving across PMLI, with reusable interfaces to data and feature infrastructure.
  • Lead architectures for distributed training, fine-tuning, distillation, evaluation, and high-scale CPU/GPU inference.
  • Improve efficiency across data loading, distributed execution, GPU kernels and memory, compilation, quantization, scheduling, and capacity.
  • Build reliable, observable platforms with strong quality guarantees and training/serving consistency.
  • Partner with Ads and Core AI/ML teams to productionize features and models safely at Pinterest scale.
  • Drive cross-organizational architecture decisions, migrations, and operational standards; mentor senior engineers and raise the engineering bar.
  • Use AI-assisted development and analysis to accelerate prototyping, performance diagnosis, and validation while maintaining rigorous correctness and data safeguards.

What we’re looking for:

  • A track record of setting technical strategy and delivering company-wide infrastructure initiatives in ambiguous environments.
  • Deep expertise in distributed ML systems, including production experience with both large-scale training and online inference.
  • Strong GPU performance knowledge, such as profiling, distributed execution, kernel and memory optimization, compilation, or quantization.
  • Experience with AI/ML modeling, recommender systems, Ads ranking, retrieval, feature platforms, or similarly demanding ML workloads.
  • Strong systems programming and design skills in C++, Java, or Python.
  • High ownership and sound judgment in reliability, security, cost, and operational excellence.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and critically evaluate AI-assisted work, with accountability for correctness, quality, and sensitive data.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.

We’re hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to help drive the future of merchant presence and shopping experiences on Pinterest.

This role sits on the Merchant team and focuses on building AI/ML systems (including LLMs) that identify, understand, and surface relevant, high-quality merchants across segments—so Pinners can discover new brands with greater confidence and consideration, and merchants can reach new, diverse audiences.

In this role, you’ll lead LLM-first, evaluation-driven initiatives—near-term focused on agentic workflows, measurement, and operational rigor that strengthen Merchant Integrity and Business Integrity. Longer term, you’ll help advance core relevance capabilities such as merchant/brand affinity modeling and related signals that improve shopping discovery across Pinterest. You’ll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Data Science, Design, and platform teams to take systems from early prototypes to reliable, scaled production.

You will also serve as the technical lead for ML in this space—reporting to a Director and acting as the first ML Engineering hire in this org—helping define the technical roadmap, establish engineering standards, and lay the foundation for scaling the domain and team over time. This is a high-agency, high-impact role with direct levers on user trust, relevance, and shopping outcomes across high-traffic Pinterest surfaces (organic and paid).

What you’ll do:

  • Own end-to-end technical delivery for cross-team initiatives—from problem framing and technical strategy through architecture, implementation, rollout, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Set technical direction and execution plans in partnership with a Director and cross-functional leads, including defining milestones, sequencing, and quality bars for the domain.
  • Build and evolve ML and GenAI systems that improve merchant quality and understanding (e.g., merchant content enrichment, attribute extraction/normalization, entity resolution, merchant/brand quality signals, and policy-aware transformations), with clear downstream impact on retrieval, ranking, and shopping surfaces.
  • Establish robust evaluation and measurement practices across ML + LLM-assisted systems, including golden datasets, human-in-the-loop review loops, automated regression testing, offline/online metric alignment, and clear go/no-go launch criteria for quality, safety, and performance.
  • Design systems with strong attention to quality, cost, latency, reliability, and safety, including guardrails, fallbacks, caching, and observability to support scaled production operations.
  • Establish the ML engineering operating model for the org (where applicable): evaluation standards, launch readiness reviews, monitoring/alerting, and sustainable ownership practices to keep quality high as the roadmap scales.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Trust/Policy/Legal, and ML platform teams to align on goals, constraints, and rollout plans—and to turn ambiguous needs into concrete ML deliverables.
  • Drive experimentation and iteration (A/B tests, holdouts), lead error analysis, and translate learnings into measurable improvements to user trust and shopping outcomes.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for technical design, evaluation rigor, and production readiness across the team—enabling faster, safer iteration with AI/ML tooling and best practices.
  • Help scale the domain by supporting hiring and onboarding over time (e.g., interview loops, onboarding plans, technical mentorship), as we build out ML engineering capacity.

What we’re looking for:

  • 8+ years of industry experience in ML engineering / applied ML / software engineering, including meaningful time operating as a Staff-level (or equivalent) IC delivering complex production systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead 0→1 ML/LLM efforts: taking ambiguous problem spaces, defining the approach, and delivering a production system with measurable impact.
  • Strong track record shipping ML-powered systems in domains such as recommendation, ranking, retrieval, content understanding, ads relevance, commerce, or adjacent areas with clear product impact.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications in production (or adjacent GenAI systems), with strong judgment on reliability, failure modes, rollout safety, and practical tradeoffs.
  • Deep experience with evaluation and measurement: dataset strategy, labeling/review operations, metric design, regression testing, and connecting offline improvements to online outcomes.
  • Strong systems design skills building data- and ML-intensive systems, with the ability to navigate tradeoffs in performance, reliability, scalability, and cost.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction across teams without directly owning every implementation detail.
  • Demonstrated experience building and enhancing cross-functional partnerships with other teams and organizations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent practical experience.

As a Staff Software Engineer at Pinterest, you will help define and drive the technical direction of the web development layer that product engineers build with, so teams can ship features more quickly, reliably, and consistently. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about web architecture, developer experience, and building scalable foundations for product development. While this role will have a strong focus on data fetching, it will also contribute more broadly across the systems, frameworks, and best practices that enable product engineers to build high-quality web experiences at scale including code health and our design system.

What you’ll do: 

  • Define and drive technical direction for foundational web capabilities that product engineers use directly, with a primary focus on data fetching.
  • Assess the current ecosystem of frameworks, tooling, and patterns on the web client, and identify the highest-impact opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead platform investments that simplify development, reduce friction, and improve consistency across the product engineering experience.
  • Partner across product, platform, design, and infrastructure teams to align on scalable technical patterns and long-term architecture.
  • Shape the evolution of data fetching in our hybrid GraphQL/REST environment, while contributing more broadly to framework adoption, paved paths, and code health.
  • Establish best practices, reusable abstractions, and technical guidance that raise quality and improve maintainability across the web organization.
  • Mentor engineers and influence technical direction through architecture reviews, design discussions, and cross-team leadership.
  • Contribute to a high-scale web platform serving millions of users and enabling hundreds of engineers to build product experiences effectively.

What we’re looking for:

  • 8+ years of web software engineering experience building, designing and evolving client-side data architecture in large-scale web applications.
  • Deep understanding of tradeoffs in caching, consistency, latency, reliability, and developer ergonomics in modern web clients.
  • Expert-level coding skills in languages like javascript or typescript (optional python), with ability to write production-quality code.
  • Knowledge on Node.js, server-side rendering techniques and GraphQL frameworks like Relay.
  • Strong experience working across both GraphQL and REST, with the technical judgment to define clear patterns for how and when each should be used.

As Senior Privacy Counsel (EU), you will provide strategic, product-focused privacy counseling to help Pinterest design, build, and scale products in compliance with EU privacy requirements (including GDPR and ePrivacy). In this role, you’ll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including Product, Engineering, Data, Security, Marketing, and other Legal teams—to embed privacy-by-design into the product lifecycle, guide high-impact launches, and help balance business goals with privacy compliance obligations. You’ll have the opportunity to shape and execute scalable privacy processes, including leading privacy risk assessments and supporting privacy governance across EU-facing products and features.

Our new progressive work model is called PinFlex, a term that’s uniquely Pinterest to describe our flexible approach to living and working. Visit our PinFlex landing page to learn more.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide end-to-end EU privacy product counseling for new products and feature launches, from early design through launch and iteration.
  • Advise on key GDPR, ePrivacy, DSA, EU AI Act topics, including lawful bases, transparency, consent and choice design, profiling/personalization considerations, data minimization, retention, and data subject rights implications.
  • Lead and support privacy risk assessments (including DPIAs, where applicable), driving mitigations and documenting decisions in partnership with cross-functional teams.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to operationalise privacy-by-design and scalable privacy controls (e.g., consent enforcement, data access controls, retention/deletion approaches).
  • Provide guidance on data sharing and vendor/partner arrangements impacting EU processing, including supporting negotiation of privacy terms and data protection addenda as needed.
  • Advise on international data transfers for EU data flows, partnering with internal stakeholders and outside counsel where appropriate to support compliant transfer mechanisms and risk mitigations.
  • Develop and improve scalable privacy workflows, templates, and playbooks to enable consistent, efficient privacy review across multiple teams and roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners and Legal colleagues to address privacy issues that arise from incidents, complaints, or escalations, and help drive durable process improvements.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly to improve the efficiency and consistency of privacy counseling and program workflows, while maintaining appropriate legal oversight and quality control.

What we’re looking for:

  • Qualified to practice law in the jurisdiction where you reside (or equivalent EU qualification).
  • Significant post-qualification legal experience in privacy, with substantial experience counseling on EU privacy law (including GDPR; ePrivacy knowledge strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience providing product counseling in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to translate legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for Legal, Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience leading or materially supporting DPIAs/privacy risk assessments, and driving cross-functional mitigations to enable launches while managing risk.
  • Strong understanding of how modern products handle data (e.g., data flows, analytics, SDKs/APIs, tracking/measurement concepts) sufficient to counsel effectively on privacy-by-design.
  • Excellent judgment and integrity, with strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with an ability to drive alignment across teams in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities with independence, sound judgment, and attention to detail.
  • Eagerness to learn, strong ownership, and a flexible, collaborative approach to problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI and other technology tools effectively and responsibly and identify practical opportunities to improve effectiveness, or willingness to learn.
  • Experience navigating complex, multi-jurisdictional legal and compliance issues for a technology company or similarly dynamic environment preferred.
  • Familiarity with international data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SCCs and transfer risk assessments) preferred.

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

As a Senior Staff Product Manager for Adversarial Actors, you'll own the end-to-end strategy for inauthentic behavior on Pinterest. This includes detection and enforcement for bots, account takeovers, and spam across the entire Pinterest funnel. You’ll partner closely with teams across Pinterest, including Policy, Operations, Engineering, and Data Science to protect Pinners, advertisers, and the business. 

What you'll do:

  • Define and deliver Pinterest's company-wide adversarial strategy spanning pre-authentication, login/signup, and post-authentication surfaces — setting multi-year vision, aligning executive stakeholders, and driving coordinated investment across Policy, Ops, MLE, Integrity Analytics, Data Science, Security, and Identity.
  • Develop and execute on the post-authentication roadmap, including measurement, detection signals, and enforcement actions. Support the Bots & ATO PM on pre-authentication roadmap.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to build spam account and domain signals, including network-based detection, ML models, and heuristic-based rules. 
  • Partner with the Enforcement Systems team to develop the associated suite of spam account and domain enforcement actions such as warnings, rate limits, feature restrictions, deactivations, and domain-level actions.
  • Set the metrics and measurement strategy for post-authentication spam prevalence, detection quality, and enforcement effectiveness.
  • Anticipate emerging adversarial patterns and continuously reprioritize investments to stay ahead of evolving abuse.

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum 10 years of product management experience, with deep expertise in trust & safety, account integrity, anti-abuse, or adversarial domains
  • Proven track record owning ML-powered detection products and shipping enforcement systems at scale
  • Strong data fluency — comfortable with precision/recall/FPR, prevalence measurement, and reasoning about adversarial dynamics
  • SQL proficiency — able to self-serve data investigation and analysis
  • Demonstrated systems thinking — experience navigating complex, interconnected detection and enforcement infrastructure
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and executive-level communication — proven ability to drive alignment and decisions across functions, and present strategy and recommendations to all levels of leadership. 
  • Strong judgment on policy and enforcement tradeoffs, balancing enforcement with false-positive user impact
  • Excellent written and verbal communication of complex adversarial, ML, and policy concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

The Responsible AI team is part ofthe Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.

At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.

Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations - ensuring these models are safe, bias-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies - to championing ML Fairness and developing user-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user-controllable skin tone, hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type.

You’ll help shape forward-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.

What you'll do:

  • execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI. 
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.
  • Mentor junior engineers on the Responsible AI team and across the company on the R-AI space.
  • Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.

What we're looking for:

  • Extensive, real-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology - spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.
  • Deep familiarity with cutting-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer-based models, 2-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large-scale Search and Recommender Systems.
  • Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state-of-the-art research with tangible product impact.
  • 2+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products
  • Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields
  • Nice to have:
    • Publications at top ML conferences
    • Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring
    • Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration
    • Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data
    • Passion for applied research and the Pinterest product

Pinterest's Ads Delivery Infrastructure team builds and operates the real-time serving, indexing, retrieval, and budgeting systems that power Shopping and Ads at Pinterest. What You'll Do:

  • Lead or support programs that scale Pinterest's Shopping and Ads catalog, indexing, and retrieval systems to handle billions of items, partnering with engineering leads across catalog, search infrastructure, and retrieval.
  • Drive cross-team execution on infrastructure modernization initiatives, including migrations to next-generation compute and storage platforms, managing timeline, dependency, and risk across service owners.
  • Build and maintain program dashboards and reporting that give engineering and business stakeholders a clear, current view of progress, risk, and decisions.
  • Partner with engineering on reliability and incident-response initiatives for revenue-critical serving systems.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and program status clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, from individual engineers to senior leadership.

  • Prototype solutions to augment decisions through data (e.g. dashboards, data analysis) or simplify processes (e.g. process and workflow helpers, or internal tools) using AI coding assistants (“vibe coding”).
  • Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance, and safety-by-design: appropriately handle sensitive data, validate AI-generated outputs, document assumptions/limits, and ensure AI-assisted workflows meet applicable policy/compliance expectations before broad adoption.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of TPM/Product Ownership experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs, ideally within large-scale distributed systems, search/retrieval, or ads/monetization infrastructure.
  • Solid understanding of the principles behind large-scale serving, indexing, or retrieval systems, and the tradeoffs involved in scaling them.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience building dashboards, interpreting data, and using insights to drive decisions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering with senior engineering and business stakeholders in high-visibility settings.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities across a fast-moving, multi-workstream roadmap.
  • Experience with ads, monetization, or data infrastructure is a plus; willingness to learn and grow across domains is essential.
  • Workflow design, AI fluency, data & insights orientation: experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low-toil mechanisms and improving decision-making by using GenAI (e.g., strong prompting, vibe coding lightweight scripts/tools, dashboards, data analysis and leveraging agents where appropriate)

Billions of dollars flow through Retail Media Networks (RMNs) onto advertising platforms like Pinterest every year, but it can be a sub-par experience for the RMN, the brand advertiser, and for Pinterest.  The RMN’s fees are hidden, campaign setup and management is manual and slow, and Pinterest gets left out of most of the relationship.  Pinterest Media Network Connect (PMNC) is Pinterest’s solution to this problem, with complete transparency and self-service capabilities.  Pinterest was the first to do this style of solution to the problem, and it is being copied by larger adverting platforms as a result, so we know we’re on the right path.

But changing the retail media network business is not enough.  We have ambitions to support a fully transparent, fully self-service audience marketplace, where anyone can transact with anyone else to empower their campaigns with audiences that enhance their performance and reach.  

You, as the lead for PMNC and audience marketplace, will grow our RMN offerings and build the audience marketplace business from the ground up.  Leading these products involves collaborating with a dynamic, motivated, and expert team of cross functional partners to build brand new systems, develop relationships with partners, automate processes, and champion our solutions internally.  Your success will depend on leading the company through significant process changes, having deep empathy for our partners and advertisers, partnering with many stakeholders internally and externally.

What you’ll do:

Pinterest is uniquely positioned across the full consumer journey—from inspiration and discovery through consideration, planning, and action. As advertisers increasingly rely on independent measurement partners to validate performance and guide investment, Pinterest has an opportunity to turn trusted measurement into a powerful engine for better outcomes. This role will define how Pinterest connects partner measurement with insights, recommendations, activation workflows, and ads optimization—helping advertisers understand the value they derive from Pinterest and act on those insights to maximize measurable business results.

The ideal candidate is a Staff-level product leader with substantial ads measurement and performance advertising experience. They understand the measurement partner ecosystem, how advertisers evaluate sales and long-term value, and how independent measurement can inform media planning, activation, and optimization. They have worked cross-functionally with engineering, data science, partnerships, marketing science, PMM, sales, legal, privacy, and policy teams and can translate complex methodologies and partner data into credible, scalable products.

What you’ll do:

Own the strategy and end-to-end execution for Measurement Partner Optimization and for productizing performance optimization at Pinterest, with measurement as the tip of the spear. Define the vision for new and existing capabilities that turn trusted partner measurement into scalable insights, recommendations, activation workflows, and optimization products. Translate advertiser and partner needs into clear product, data, and technical requirements, and deliver a multi-quarter roadmap that drives measurable advertiser outcomes.

Partner day-to-day with engineering, data science/analytics, partnerships, marketing science, and product teams to align partner-platform architecture, data contracts, methodological standards, experimentation, privacy controls, and optimization guardrails. Collaborate with PMM, sales, legal, privacy, and policy/integrity on launches, and coordinate dependencies across the ads stack so client measurement systems, Pinterest infrastructure, ads delivery systems, and customer-facing experiences work together cohesively and credibly.

Build new and iterate on measurement-to-optimization products that help advertisers understand Pinterest’s incremental value and take action to improve sales, return on ad spend, and long-term business outcomes. Establish validation and quality standards, define success metrics up front, drive go-to-market and adoption, monitor product and partner performance after launch, and use advertiser feedback and measured results to continuously improve the roadmap.

  • Minimum 8 years of experience working as a Product Manager or in a related role, including 3–5+ years of substantial ads or marketing measurement experience.

  • Deep understanding of performance marketing, how advertisers establish objectives and deploy tactics, and how they evaluate outcomes including incremental sales, return on ad spend, and long-term value.
  • Experience working with engineering, data science, analytics, partnerships, marketing science, research, or PMM cross-functional teams, as well as directly with advertisers, agencies, or external partners.
  • Strong quantitative judgment and understanding of attribution, incrementality, experimentation, lift, partner methodologies, data quality, and measurement tradeoffs.

Pinterest is looking for a Sr. Staff Qualitative Researcher to lead research in our highest-priority ads areas. We are looking for a seasoned researcher who can embed in complex, ambiguous problem spaces, uncover the advertiser and Pinner needs that matter most, and turn them into a clear learning agenda. In this role you’ll bring deep qual and mixed methods experience (as needed) to design, execute and communicate strategic research to senior stakeholders in the Ads org and beyond. You’ll shape strategy by partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering and presenting insights and written POVs directly to senior leadership. You’ll also help us decide where sustained research investment is needed, set direction for large cross-team research efforts, and mentor other researchers to raise the bar for qualitative craft. In this role, you’ll have ownership of a broad problem space, autonomy to set and execute your research agenda, and real influence over the ads roadmap and the holistic Pinner experience.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead high-impact qualitative research in our most strategic ads areas: Embed in one or two high-priority problem spaces and own the full research cycle from discovery through execution, delivery, and influence on product decisions.
  • Uncover and represent complex advertiser and user problems: Identify the deep, ambiguous customer needs that cut across the ads product, and translate them into clear opportunities for the business.
  • Shape the research agenda: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and quantitative UX Research to scope and prioritize the questions that matter most for the areas you support, and independently identify where research can have the greatest impact.
  • Choose the right method for the question: Plan, field, and synthesize research using the full range of qualitative methods, and partner with Data Science and quantitative researchers on mixed-methods studies that combine depth with scale.
  • Influence strategy and roadmap: Partner with PMs and Designers to deliver informed, actionable recommendations, and communicate insights directly to leadership to help shape product direction. Author written POVs and cross-study syntheses that connect findings into a bigger picture.
  • Assess where sustained research investment is needed: Evaluate whether an area warrants a long-term research presence, and make the case to leadership for where to invest.
  • Use AI to amplify your craft:. Bring creativity to how you apply AI tools to research workflows and to how you land learnings, making cross-functional collaboration faster and more effective.
  • Provide vision and direction for large collaborative efforts: Lead cross-team research initiatives across the ads organization (and as needed across ads and consumer orgs), setting direction and aligning partners around a shared point of view.
  • Mentor and raise the bar: Coach and develop other researchers, and elevate qualitative craft across the team.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in qualitative or mixed-methods user research, with a track record of leading research at a staff or senior staff level in a product organization, ideally in ads, marketplaces, or B2B/B2C platforms.
  • Deep expertise across the qualitative toolkit. Fluency in interviews, ethnography, diary studies, usability testing, concept testing, and other methods, with sound judgment about which approach best fits the question, timeline, and decision at hand.
  • Experience in mixed-methods research. Demonstrated success partnering with Data Science and quantitative UX Research to combine qualitative depth with quantitative scale, and to triangulate findings across data sources.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and roadmap supported by strong storytelling and recommendations that can drive action
  • Strong executive communication skills and comfort presenting insights, written POVs, and recommendations to senior leaders (Sr. Directors +) and cross-functional partners, and tailoring the message to the audience.
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and take an unstructured, high-urgency problem space, define the right questions, and build a learning agenda with minimal direction.
  • Strong strategic judgment and decision quality to assess where research will have the greatest impact, prioritize accordingly, and make a clear case for where sustained investment is (or isn’t) warranted.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with PMs, Designers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and quantitative researchers, and to build trust and credibility across disciplines.
  • Experience leading large, collaborative research efforts with proven ability to set vision and direction across teams, align stakeholders around a shared point of view, and drive complex initiatives to completion.
  • Curiosity and creativity in using AI tools. Enthusiasm for applying AI to research workflows, from synthesis to storytelling, to work faster and land insights in more compelling ways. Working knowledge of standard AI based research tools and capabilities preferred. 
  • Familiarity with ads (preferred). Understanding of advertiser needs, ad ecosystems and challenges is a plus, though not required.

Our Ads Quality organization builds the machine-learning systems that make ads relevant and valuable to Pinners while delivering meaningful outcomes for advertisers.

We are seeking a Director of Machine Learning Engineering to lead a broad portfolio of Ads Quality modeling teams focused on engagement, conversion, ROAS optimization, ranking, representation learning, and ML-powered experimentation.

In this role, you will shape and drive a unified technical strategy across Ads Quality, leading teams responsible for engagement ranking, oCPM and conversion modeling, ROAS optimization, lightweight ranking and retrieval models, foundation model adoption, sequence and multimodal modeling, and the quality and efficiency of production machine learning systems.

What you’ll do: 

  • Set the technical vision and multi-year strategy for Ads Quality machine learning, connecting model innovation to Pinner value, advertiser performance, revenue, and marketplace health.
  • Lead and develop a group of engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and machine-learning engineers across multiple modeling domains.
  • Establish a coherent modeling roadmap across engagement, conversion, ROAS, relevance, ranking, and foundation-model initiatives.
  • Drive improvements in model quality, calibration, generalization, cold-start performance, attribution, and robustness across Pinterest surfaces.
  • Guide the evolution of Ads models toward larger, more generalizable architectures, including foundation models, distillation, long-context sequence modeling, multimodal representations, and cross-domain learning.
  • Ensure that modeling investments translate into reliable production outcomes through strong offline evaluation, online experimentation, launch discipline, and post-launch monitoring.
  • Partner closely with Ads Product, Ads Data Science, Ads Signals, Ads Retrieval, Ads Delivery, Measurement, Core, ATG, and ML Infrastructure.
  • Set expectations for training-serving parity, data quality, privacy, reliability, latency, capacity, and cost efficiency.
  • Improve engineering velocity through better experimentation workflows, reusable modeling infrastructure, automation, and agentic development tools.
  • Build a culture of technical excellence, candid collaboration, inclusion, ownership, and continuous learning.
  • Represent Ads Quality ML in senior leadership forums and communicate strategy, tradeoffs, risks, and results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 12 years of experience building and deploying machine-learning systems, including significant experience leading managers and multi-team organizations.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale recommendation, ranking, advertising, search, marketplace, or personalization ML teams.
  • Strong understanding of modern deep-learning and recommender-system techniques, including sequence models, embeddings, multimodal models, multi-task learning, foundation models, distillation, and reinforcement learning.
  • Experience with conversion, value, ROAS, bidding, or other lower-funnel optimization problems is strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to connect modeling objectives and offline metrics to online experiments and business outcomes.
  • Experience operating production ML systems with demanding requirements for latency, availability, calibration, privacy, reliability, and cost.
  • Strong judgment in balancing near-term product delivery with foundational technical investments.
  • Track record of building high-performing organizations, developing senior leaders, and creating effective operating mechanisms.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.

As a Lead Digital Producer on Pinterest’s House of Creative team, you'll lead complex digital experiences with primary ownership of production for Pinterest’s business-facing web ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Technology, Marketing, and Operations, partnering closely with Digital Strategy, Design, and cross-functional teams to turn business and creative ambition into scalable, executable digital experiences.

The Business Site will be the primary priority, but the remit is broader than a single website. This producer will also lead production across campaign and launch experiences, event and registration platforms, newsroom and other digital touchpoints that require strong creative, technical, and operational leadership.

This is not a traditional website project-management role. We’re looking for a senior producer who combines strong digital production expertise with technical fluency, strategic judgment, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional teams through ambiguity.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead end-to-end digital production from early definition through launch across websites, campaign experiences, event/registration platforms, and other digital touchpoints
  • Translate digital strategy, business requirements, and creative ambition into clear production approaches, scopes, workbacks, staffing plans, budgets, technical requirements, and launch plans
  • Partner closely with Digital Strategy and Site leads on roadmap execution, sequencing, feasibility, platform implications, and production tradeoffs
  • Partner deeply with Design and UX to determine how creative ideas can be realized across responsive experiences, design systems, reusable components, and technical constraints
  • Evaluate platforms, vendors, and implementation approaches against business, creative, technical, operational, and financial requirements; help determine when to use an existing platform, third-party solution, or custom build
  • Bring working fluency across CMS environments, integrations/APIs, analytics and tracking, accessibility, localization, privacy/legal requirements, QA, SEO, and digital release processes
  • Serve as the connective tissue across Strategy, Design, Engineering, Analytics, SEO, Marketing, Comms, Legal/Privacy, Localization, and external partners, creating clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and handoffs
  • Anticipate technical and operational risk, surface tradeoffs early, and ensure changes in scope, timing, requirements, or platform capability lead to explicit decisions rather than downstream teams silently absorbing the impact
  • Build strong production rhythms and repeatable systems that improve visibility, accountability, speed, and scalability across the digital portfolio
  • Manage and evaluate external digital agencies, development partners, platforms, and specialist vendors
  • Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate appropriate digital-production workflows such as research, requirements synthesis, planning, documentation, QA support, and repetitive tasks while maintaining critical judgment, accuracy, privacy, and ownership of final outcomes

What we’re looking for:

  • A minimum of 7 years of experience in digital production, web production, creative technology production, or a closely related discipline across agency and/or in-house teams
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as marketing, communications, digital media or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex digital experiences end to end, including large websites, platform implementations, campaign experiences, event/registration experiences, or comparable digital products
  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to evaluate platforms, vendors, integrations, CMS approaches, implementation complexity, and technical risk without needing to be the engineer
  • Proven ability to lead highly cross-functional programs across Strategy, Design/UX, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, SEO, Legal/Privacy, Localization, and external partners
  • Strong strategic judgment and the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear production options, recommendations, and tradeoffs
  • Excellent communication and leadership presence, including the ability to influence without authority and make complex technical or operational issues understandable to senior stakeholders
  • Experience in using AI to improve the speed and quality of research, planning, documentation or other core work
  • Strong operational discipline across scoping, resourcing, budgets, schedules, dependencies, QA, launch readiness, and risk management
  • Experience evaluating and managing digital agencies, development partners, platforms, and vendors
  • Comfortable operating autonomously across multiple workstreams and serving as a trusted digital-production partner to senior Creative, Marketing, and Digital Strategy leaders
